SEG-ORDER.interpretation: Validate receive sequence first; reject unacceptable segments before ACK/window processing; process ACK/window before text. Future ACK causes ACK+drop; old ACK does not discard accepted payload.

SEG-ACK.interpretation: Cumulative ACK removes acknowledged retransmission prefix. Full ACK cancels rtx, new partial ACK restarts it, duplicate/old ACK leaves its deadline. ACK-only valid segments do not cause ACK loops.

SEG-WINDOW.interpretation: Update advertised peer window only for SND.UNA <= SEG.ACK <= SND.NXT with fresh WL1/WL2; SEG.SEQ uses the original accepted wire header in this profile.

SEG-SHRINK.interpretation: Sender remains robust when the usable window becomes negative (MUST-34). No new data is sent beyond the current window; retransmit oldest outstanding data within the positive window (SHLD-15/16).

SEG-ZERO-FLIGHT.interpretation: With outstanding data and zero peer window, the existing timeout sends one oldest octet as a probe and backs off. Zero window with only unsent data still requires the later persist mechanism.

SEG-SCOPE.interpretation: Inherit finite buffers/connection and explicit reassembly, expand accepted ACK+payload/window composition and shrinking windows; first accepted byte wins, raw accepted SEG.SEQ used for WL1. Only ESTABLISHED, no FIN data or full recovery/persist implementation.
